title: Theorem 2 in Sample (2026)
headline: The upper bound in Theorem 2 fails for claim-size distributions that the stated assumptions allow (a missing assumption). The authors disagree; their reply is summarised below.

work.title: Bounds on Ruin Probabilities for Compound Renewal Processes

claims.label: Theorem 2
claims.statement: For every claim-size distribution with a finite second moment, the ruin probability is bounded above by the stated exponential expression.
conditions: claim sizes with finite second moment
claims.quantifiers: for every claim-size distribution with a finite second moment

result.witness: A claim-size distribution with a finite second moment but an infinite third moment violates the bound; the calculation is in the evidence package.
result.repair_note: Assuming a finite third moment restores the bound in all cases checked.
not_claimed: The bound is not claimed to fail for distributions with a finite third moment.
The paper's other results are not examined here.
